
```{r}
sce <- readRDS("/projects/shared/intronic_bam/datasets/BE1/BE1_sce.RDS")
```

```{r}
sce
```

```{r}
colData(sce)
```

```{r}
table(sce$cell_status, sce$Sample)
```

# Features selection

```{r}
dec.sce <- modelGeneVar(sce)
```


```{r}
# Visualizing the fit:
fit.sce <- metadata(dec.sce)
plot(fit.sce$mean, fit.sce$var, xlab="Mean of log-expression",
    ylab="Variance of log-expression")
curve(fit.sce$trend(x), col="dodgerblue", add=TRUE, lwd=2)
```

```{r}
hvg.var <- getTopHVGs(dec.sce, n = 2000)
hvg.var.sign <- getTopHVGs(dec.sce, fdr.threshold=0.05)
hvg.var.prop <- getTopHVGs(dec.sce, prop=0.2)
length(hvg.var)
length(hvg.var.sign)
length(hvg.var.prop)
```

```{r}
rowSubset(sce) <- hvg.var # stored in the default 'subset'.
rowSubset(sce, "HVGs.fdr") <- hvg.var.sign
rowSubset(sce, "HVGs.prop20") <- hvg.var.prop
colnames(rowData(sce))
```


```{r}
sce.hvg <- sce[hvg.var,]
```

```{r}
set.seed(1000)
sce.hvg <- fixedPCA(sce.hvg, 
    BSPARAM=RandomParam(), name="randomized")

reducedDimNames(sce.hvg)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1100101001)
sce.hvg <- runUMAP(sce.hvg, dimred="PCA")
```


```{r}
plotReducedDim(sce.hvg, dimred="UMAP", colour_by="Sample")
```


```{r}
plotReducedDim(sce.hvg , dimred="PCA", ncomponents=4,
    colour_by="Sample")
```

```{r}
plotReducedDim(sce.hvg , dimred="PCA", colour_by="Sample", point_size = 1)
```


# Clustering

```{r}

nn.clusters <- clusterCells(sce.hvg, use.dimred="PCA")
table(nn.clusters)
```

```{r}
colLabels(sce.hvg) <- nn.clusters
plotReducedDim(sce.hvg, "UMAP", colour_by="label")
```

```{r}
set.seed(100)
clust.kmeans <- clusterCells(sce.hvg, use.dimred="PCA", 
    BLUSPARAM=KmeansParam(centers=7))
table(clust.kmeans)
```

```{r}
colLabels(sce.hvg) <- clust.kmeans
plotReducedDim(sce.hvg, "UMAP", colour_by="label")
```

```{r}
table(sce.hvg$Sample, sce.hvg$label)
```
